scope: Working-tree evidence for immutable numeric element-child positions on findings for admitted direct simple DOCX fields. Complex fields and other findings retain null positions; plan reuse and policy remain open.
provenance: Two synthetic DOCX inputs were independently authored with MIT fixture helpers, without wordnet serialization; two generations were byte-identical. Open XML SDK 3.5.1 validated both inputs. Python independently parsed XML element-child positions and compared default privacy-safe reports and explicit synthetic alias observations; nine in-memory altered controls were rejected.
